from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=18.74, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 3.98 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.77, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 3.95 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=9.77, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 7.5 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.78, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 6.0 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.99, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 6.73 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=18.53, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 1.55 * vars['Var_5']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(-5.94 * vars['Var_0'] + 7.12 * vars['Var_1'] + -1.21 * vars['Var_2'] + -0.85 * vars['Var_3'] + -0.63 * vars['Var_5'] >= -18.33, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(-7.02 * vars['Var_1'] + -9.79 * vars['Var_2'] + -9.22 * vars['Var_3'] + 8.99 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.76 * vars['Var_5'] >= -87.15, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(-7.82 * vars['Var_0'] + 8.36 * vars['Var_1'] + -5.64 * vars['Var_2'] + -7.11 * vars['Var_3'] + -4.1 * vars['Var_4'] + -0.36 * vars['Var_5'] >= -66.62, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(-0.11 * vars['Var_0'] + 2.44 * vars['Var_1'] + -2.71 * vars['Var_2'] + -9.77 * vars['Var_4'] + 0.74 * vars['Var_5'] >= -13.18, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(3.7 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.01 * vars['Var_1'] + -7.52 * vars['Var_2'] + -4.6 * vars['Var_4'] + -6.24 * vars['Var_5'] >= -25.81, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(2.34 * vars['Var_0'] + -4.8 * vars['Var_1'] + 8.49 * vars['Var_2'] + -3.46 * vars['Var_3'] + 4.1 * vars['Var_4'] + -3.46 * vars['Var_5'] >= 48.23, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(6.83 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.63 * vars['Var_1'] + -2.2 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.61 * vars['Var_3'] + 2.91 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.87 * vars['Var_5'] >= 52.84, name='C6')
    m.addConstr(7.84 * vars['Var_0'] + -6.02 * vars['Var_1'] + -7.54 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.65 * vars['Var_3'] + 7.53 * vars['Var_5'] >= -15.29, name='C7')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
